# engine_stream: src/engine/stream/ (tools/engine_layout.py).
# Generated by tools/move_engine_files.py; edited by hand from here on.

add_library(engine_stream STATIC)

file(GLOB ENGINE_STREAM_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cc"
)
list(FILTER ENGINE_STREAM_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "_test(_util)?\\.cc$")

file(GLOB ENGINE_STREAM_HEADERS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h"
)

target_sources(engine_stream PRIVATE
        ${ENGINE_STREAM_SOURCES}
)

target_sources(engine_stream PUBLIC
        FILE_SET HEADERS
        BASE_DIRS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        FILES ${ENGINE_STREAM_HEADERS}
)

target_link_libraries(engine_stream
        PUBLIC engine_platform absl::check absl::core_headers
)

# Tests
include(Testing)
add_gtest(
        NAME engine_stream_test
        SOURCES archive_test.cc byte_stream_test.cc memory_stream_test.cc range_stream_test.cc
            tee_sink_test.cc
        LIBS engine_stream
)
